title: Jingle Bells
short: James Lord Pierpont · C 4/4 · play it with every note lit.

blocks.html: The tune stays on the open strings and the first three frets, and it leans on the open E string. The strum is the folk strum: down, down-up, (miss), up-down-up. Keep the hand moving down and up even where it misses the strings, and the rhythm takes care of itself. Bar 7 changes from C to G7 halfway through.

blocks.name: music-player
blocks.cap: Play it: the score scrolls, the keys or strings light up as each note sounds.

blocks.html: The piece: “The One Horse Open Sleigh” (1857): the chorus as it is sung today

sources.name: Melody as in our piano version of Jingle Bells, whose chorus was checked note by note against an ABC tune file from a University of Calgary course page (pages.cpsc.ucalgary.ca). The chords follow that version’s left hand, with G7 for G. Our checking script compares the two melodies beat by beat.
